rationale.conceptual: Standard DFT calculations with established exchange-correlation functionals and a published semi-empirical hardness model; no novel algorithms or derivations required.
rationale.execution: Requires automating many DFT runs (18 geometry relaxations, 18 elastic constant calculations, 18 DOS runs) across nine compounds and two functionals, then post-processing with Voigt-Reuss-Hill averaging and hardness formulas; multi-stage pipeline with dependencies.

difficulty.reasoning: The paper applies standard DFT using PBE and LDA functionals and a semi-empirical hardness model to a series of monocarbides. No novel algorithms are involved, and all steps (geometry optimization, elastic constants, DOS integration) are routine in the field. The task demands a multi-step pipeline with a large number of DFT runs, but the computations themselves are small and the method is well-established.

compute_estimate.reasoning: Small unit cells (2 atoms) with moderate plane-wave cutoff and k-point grid; the calculations are lightweight and CPU-only, with no large datasets.
